content.text: The redline validated. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: are the property of Company to the extent that such Works were created by Contractor for Company over a time period for which Company has been invoiced and said invoice has been paid.
input.rationale: Section 4(a) makes our ownership of the Works contingent on the relevant invoice having been issued and paid, so title in work product we commissioned does not vest on creation and there is no present assignment from Contractor — leaving Contractor as owner of unpaid-for deliverables and requiring only "reasonably required assistance" at our cost. The Agreement also contains no provision confirming that Clear Capital retains ownership of its own data and pre-existing IP (our data is addressed only as Confidential Information in § 8), and no bar on joint ownership. The licence back in § 4(c) for Contractor's Information embedded in the Works is perpetual and royalty-free but not irrevocable or worldwide, falling short of the preferred position. Contractor's retention of its own proprietary tools and methodologies under § 4(b) is acceptable and left intact. Redline: vest the Works in us on creation with an express irrevocable assignment, add a Company Data / pre-existing IP ownership and no-joint-ownership provision, and make the embedded-IP licence irrevocable and worldwide.

proposal.summary: Works vest in Company on creation with an express assignment; add Company Data/pre-existing IP ownership and no joint ownership; make the embedded-Contractor-IP licence irrevocable and worldwide.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We own what we pay for and everything we put in, so we have made ownership of the Works vest in us on creation with an express assignment rather than being conditioned on invoices having been paid (our payment protection is the fee and termination provisions, not IP title). We have also confirmed that our data and pre-existing IP remain ours with no assignment to Contractor and no joint ownership, and made the licence to Contractor's Information embedded in the Works irrevocable and worldwide so we can keep using the Works after the engagement ends.

ops.text: (e) Company retains all right, title and interest in and to all data, content, materials, software and other intellectual property provided or made available by Company, or generated for or on behalf of Company, in connection with the Services ("Company Data"), and nothing in this Agreement operates as an assignment, transfer or licence (other than a licence to Contractor to use Company Data solely as necessary to perform the Services) of any Company Data or Company intellectual property to Contractor. Nothing in this Agreement creates joint ownership of the Works or Company Data.
